comment: Transfer budgets for the assets a visitor downloads, in gzipped bytes.
Gzipped because that is what crosses the wire; raw size would let a
change that compresses badly pass while the page got slower.
Only front-end assets are listed. Editor bundles are large and irrelevant
to a reader, so budgeting all of dist/ would drown the signal.
Thresholds sit roughly 15% above what the theme ships today, recorded
below. That headroom is for ordinary growth; a change that needs the
budget raised should say why in its commit message.
pnpm perf measures what the numbers here cannot: LCP, CLS and TBT.

budgets.note: Global stylesheet, loaded on every page.
GSAP with ScrollTrigger. The single largest thing a visitor downloads, on every page. If this needs raising, first ask whether it can be loaded only where it is used.

groups.name: block front-end assets
groups.note: Loaded per block, so no single page pays all of it. Budgeted together because the total is what grows unnoticed as blocks are added.
